kind: must-be-deep
depth: deep
reason: deep-count-for-each
-- base/main.tf --
module "child" {
  source = "./modules/child"
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  count = module.child.n
  name  = "q"
}
-- base/modules/child/main.tf --
output "n" {
  value = 1
}
-- head/main.tf --
module "child" {
  source = "./modules/child"
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  count = module.child.n
  name  = "q"
}
-- head/modules/child/main.tf --
output "n" {
  value = 2
}
